subject: Ivy Chen — Interview day: draft plan, panel order, and debrief roles
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@example.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Interview day availability + rough agenda idea

Hi Ivy,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us. We'd like to propose a single virtual interview day so we can compress the loop and get you a decision quickly. Below is a very rough plan — none of this is final, we're just trying to align availability and any constraints up front.

Proposed day (Pacific):
- 09:30–10:00 AM — quick intro + product walkthrough (Logan)
- 10:15–11:15 AM — system design deep-dive (Marissa)
- 11:30–12:15 PM — behavioral + leadership panel (Tessa, Kimberly)
- 12:15–12:45 PM — lunch break (we'll pause invites)
- 01:00–02:00 PM — paired design/coding (Logan + engineer)
- 02:15–02:45 PM — closing Q&A + feedback sync (hiring team)

A few logistics/questions for you:
1) Do you prefer morning or afternoon for the live coding slot? (Some folks prefer earlier when they're freshest.)
2) Any restrictions we should know about (phone stable connection, time windows to avoid)?
3) Can you attach an updated resume/portfolio if anything changed?

I've cc'd Tessa (hiring manager) to loop her in. Once you confirm times, we'll lock panel sequencing and share calendar invites + a short prep doc.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: IvyChen_Resume.pdf (stub)
From: Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@example.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview day availability + rough agenda idea

Hi Laura —

Thanks, this looks great. I can do the proposed date. A couple notes:
- I prefer the coding exercise in the morning (my brain is sharper before lunch).
- I need to step out between 15:00–16:00 PDT for a standing appointment, so anything later than 15:00 PDT won't work.
- I attached a slightly updated resume and a short portfolio link (first item is a quick demo).

Attached: IvyChen_Resume.pdf, IvyChen_Portfolio_Link.txt

Happy to be flexible otherwise.

Best,
Ivy

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate day plan — please confirm panel order & scribe

Team —

Ivy confirmed and prefers the coding block in the morning; she also has a hard stop at 15:00 PDT. I updated the draft schedule to respect that. Key asks: please review the sequencing below and reply with a single-line confirm/no within 24 hours so I can lock invites.

Updated (Pacific):
- 09:00–09:30 — intro + product walkthrough (Logan)
- 09:45–10:45 — paired coding exercise (Logan + pairing engineer) — candidate prefers morning
- 11:00–11:45 — system design deep-dive (Marissa)
- 12:00–12:30 — behavioral + leadership panel (Tessa, Kimberly)
- 12:30–13:15 — lunch (candidate)
- 13:30–14:00 — closing Q&A + hiring sync (all)

Operational notes:
- Scribe for feedback: Kimberly? If you're okay, please capture rubrics in the shared evaluator doc.
- Rubric link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Interview-Prep/IvyChen
- Candidate timezone: PDT (she's local) — please avoid scheduling after 15:00 PDT.
- We will compress break windows, please end discussions on time.

Attachments/stubs: IvyChen_Resume.pdf, IvyChen_Portfolio_Link.txt

If you have a hard no on sequencing (e.g., need to run design before coding), say so. Otherwise I'll lock invites tomorrow morning and send candidate-facing calendar invites + prep notes.

Thanks,
Laura

Subject: Final schedule + invites (Friday, Jul 24)

Hi Ivy —

Thanks for confirming details and for the quick turnaround, team. All panels confirmed — below is the finalized plan for Friday, Jul 24 (all times PDT). I've also included prep notes and links.

Final schedule (Pacific) — Jul 24:
- 09:00–09:25 — Intro & product walkthrough (Logan) — Google Meet link: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
- 09:35–10:35 — Paired coding exercise (Logan + engineer) — codeshare: https://codeshare.io/ivy-pairing
- 10:50–11:30 — System design deep-dive (Marissa) — design doc: https://drive.google.com/design/ivy
- 11:45–12:15 — Behavioral + leadership panel (Tessa, Kimberly) — scribe: Kimberly
- 12:15–13:00 — Lunch (we'll pause invites)
- 13:15–13:45 — Closing Q&A + hiring sync (all)

Prep & expectations:
- Please join each Meet link 5 minutes early.
- For the coding exercise: we'll use the codeshare link above and expect a 45–60 minute live pairing window. No setup required beyond the links.
- Evaluator rubric will be available in the Drive folder during the day. Kimberly will be the scribe for the behavioral panel.

I've attached your resume as we received it and a one-page prep doc in the Drive folder. Calendar invites are on the way from HiringOps; please confirm when you receive them.

If anything changes on your side (or you need to adjust windows), let me know as soon as possible. Otherwise we'll see you Friday morning.

Warmly,
Laura Bennett
